verdict.rationale: Vanta's risk product documents a risk register that can be seeded from 100+ pre-built risk scenarios with suggested control mappings, or imported from an existing register. It also automates reminders and workflows for regular assessment, which covers the register, control linkage and review cycles. missing for 10: documented risk scoring, treatment plans, per-risk owners, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, a real risk register lives in the platform — scored risks, treatment plans, owners, and review cycles tied back to controls

citations.quote: Start from 100+ pre-built risk scenarios with suggested control mappings, or import the register you already have.
Vanta automates reminders and workflows to regularly assess
Vanta simplifies and automates your risk processes, helping you work more efficiently and make informed risk decisions—all from one central platform.
